summary: Enhance your customer service skills with our Data Analytics training course. Learn to leverage data for improved decision-making and customer satisfaction.
lede: Data Analytics for Customer Service teaches you to connect service questions with reliable data preparation, analysis, interpretation, and action using the CRISP-DM structure. You will clean customer service data, validate its quality, calculate measures such as CSAT, NPS, CES, FCR, AHT, abandonment rate, and service-level attainment, and identify contact drivers and root causes. You will practise with Microsoft Excel, SQL examples, and Microsoft Power BI to create a data dictionary, KPI scorecard, Pareto chart, and management dashboard. Using realistic sample datasets and controlled assumptions, you will segment contacts, assess performance across channels, explore AI-assisted sentiment classification, and present KPI-linked recommendations through a concise reporting pack.
audienceIntro: Data Analytics for Customer Service is designed for professionals who need to use customer interaction data to monitor service delivery, explain performance changes, and recommend practical improvements. It suits foundation-to-intermediate learners who can work with basic spreadsheets and want stronger analytical capability.
modules: Excel and SQL Service Data Preparation
Power BI Dashboards for Service Operations
prerequisites: You need a basic ability to work with spreadsheets and interpret common customer service terms such as response time, resolution, escalation, and satisfaction. No programming background is required. Bring a laptop if the delivery format permits hands-on work. TrainingCred can provide sample customer interaction and survey datasets, templates, and guided exercises. Access to Microsoft Excel and Power BI Desktop is useful but not essential where the provider supplies equivalent demonstrations or files.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
